lakes.name: Ukkadam Lake
lakes.description: Also known as Periyakulam Ukkadam feeder, a historic Chola dynasty lake spread over 300+ acres, critical for groundwater recharge.

lakes.name: Valankulam Lake
lakes.description: Situated between Trichy Road and Sungam bypass; vital urban wetland home to migratory birds and recently rejuvenated lakefront promenade.

lakes.name: Periyakulam
lakes.description: The largest freshwater reservoir lake in Coimbatore city center featuring modern eco-restoration, floating wetlands, and leisure walkways.

lakes.name: Kurichi Lake
lakes.description: Expansive southern lake connected to the Noyyal river system; serves agricultural zones and rapidly expanding residential catchments.

lakes.name: Singanallur Lake
lakes.description: Declared a Biodiversity Heritage Site; hosts over 110 bird species, 390 plant species, and fragile marshland buffer zones.

lakes.name: Selvachinthamani Lake
lakes.description: Urban lake located near Perur bypass road, receiving canal inflows from Noyyal system, undergoing smart city desiltation.

lakes.name: Kumarasamy Lake
lakes.description: Popularly called Muthannankulam; prominent water body near Thadagam road surrounded by dense residential wards.

lakes.name: Krishnampathy Lake
lakes.description: Upstream lake on the Selvampathy feeder chain in west Coimbatore; crucial for storm water mitigation during North-East monsoons.

issue_categories.name: Garbage / Solid Waste
issue_categories.description: Plastic trash, commercial packing waste, and domestic solid refuse accumulated on water edges.

issue_categories.name: Sewage Inflow
issue_categories.description: Untreated sewage outfall, greywater diversion, or leaking municipal drainage entering lake basin.

issue_categories.name: Water Hyacinth / Excess Vegetation
issue_categories.description: Dense mats of invasive Eichhornia crassipes or weed cover blocking sunlight and oxygen transfer.

issue_categories.name: Algal Bloom
issue_categories.description: Rapid micro-algal proliferation resulting in emerald discoloration, scum layer, or cyanobacteria crust.

issue_categories.name: Foul Odour
issue_categories.description: Noxious hydrogen sulfide or anaerobic decomposition fumes reported by walking visitors or nearby residents.

issue_categories.name: Illegal Dumping
issue_categories.description: Unauthorized nighttime dumping of building debris, industrial sludge, or construction rubble.

issue_categories.name: Drainage Issue
issue_categories.description: Blocked storm-water sluice, broken surplus weir, or canal siltation impeding gravity flow.

issue_categories.name: Damaged Infrastructure
issue_categories.description: Cracked revetment stone walls, broken handrails, breached bund walkways, or faulty aeration aerators.

issue_categories.name: Other
issue_categories.description: Miscellaneous environmental anomalies, dead fish spotting, or shoreline soil erosion.
